parts.name: Cabinet Door (Bottom)
parts.Basic_description: This is the bottom cabinet door of the tall storage cabinet, made of MDF with a smooth finish.
parts.Functional_description: It covers and protects the bottom storage compartment, allowing access through a hinge mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Middle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the middle cabinet door of the tall storage cabinet, made of MDF with a smooth finish.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the middle storage compartment and conceals stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Top)
parts.Basic_description: This is the top cabinet door of the tall storage cabinet, made of MDF with a smooth finish.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the top storage compartment and allows access when opened.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet, made of plywood for rigidity and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports all doors and shelves, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving structural component.

parts.name: Shelf (Bottom)
parts.Basic_description: This is the bottom shelf of the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It supports items stored in the bottom compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Shelf (Lower-Middle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the lower-middle shelf of the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the lower storage space and supports stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Shelf (Middle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the middle shelf of the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a flat surface for storing items in the central compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Shelf (Upper-Middle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the upper-middle shelf of the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It supports items stored in the upper-middle compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Shelf (Top)
parts.Basic_description: This is the top shelf of the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It supports items stored in the top compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.
